event_outcome_links_target_check.name: event_outcome_links_target_check
event_outcome_links_target_check.value: ("legislation"."event_outcome_links"."action_id" is not null and "legislation"."event_outcome_links"."vote_id" is null) or ("legislation"."event_outcome_links"."action_id" is null and "legislation"."event_outcome_links"."vote_id" is not null)

event_participants_target_check.name: event_participants_target_check
event_participants_target_check.value: "legislation"."event_participants"."person_id" is not null or "legislation"."event_participants"."organization_id" is not null or length("legislation"."event_participants"."name") > 0

ingestion_runs_completion_check.name: ingestion_runs_completion_check
ingestion_runs_completion_check.value: ("legislation"."ingestion_runs"."status" = 'running' and "legislation"."ingestion_runs"."completed_at" is null) or ("legislation"."ingestion_runs"."status" <> 'running' and "legislation"."ingestion_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

jurisdictions_provenance_complete_check.name: jurisdictions_provenance_complete_check
jurisdictions_provenance_complete_check.value: not "legislation"."jurisdictions"."provenance_complete" or ("legislation"."jurisdictions"."source_url" ~ '^https://' and length(btrim("legislation"."jurisdictions"."source_provider")) > 0 and "legislation"."jurisdictions"."source_retrieved_at" is not null and "legislation"."jurisdictions"."source_is_official" is not null)

legislative_sessions_dates_check.name: legislative_sessions_dates_check
legislative_sessions_dates_check.value: "legislation"."legislative_sessions"."start_date" is null or "legislation"."legislative_sessions"."end_date" is null or "legislation"."legislative_sessions"."start_date" <= "legislation"."legislative_sessions"."end_date"

legislative_sessions_provenance_complete.name: legislative_sessions_provenance_complete_check
legislative_sessions_provenance_complete.value: not "legislation"."legislative_sessions"."provenance_complete" or ("legislation"."legislative_sessions"."source_url" ~ '^https://' and length(btrim("legislation"."legislative_sessions"."source_provider")) > 0 and "legislation"."legislative_sessions"."source_retrieved_at" is not null and "legislation"."legislative_sessions"."source_is_official" is not null)

legislative_terms_dates_check.name: legislative_terms_dates_check
legislative_terms_dates_check.value: "legislation"."legislative_terms"."start_date" is null or "legislation"."legislative_terms"."end_date" is null or "legislation"."legislative_terms"."start_date" <= "legislation"."legislative_terms"."end_date"

organization_memberships_dates_check.name: organization_memberships_dates_check
organization_memberships_dates_check.value: "legislation"."organization_memberships"."start_date" is null or "legislation"."organization_memberships"."end_date" is null or "legislation"."organization_memberships"."start_date" <= "legislation"."organization_memberships"."end_date"

people_jurisdiction_source_uidx.name: people_jurisdiction_source_uidx
people_jurisdiction_source_uidx.where: "legislation"."people"."jurisdiction_id" is not null and "legislation"."people"."source_id" is not null

subscriptions_cancelled_at_check.name: subscriptions_cancelled_at_check
subscriptions_cancelled_at_check.value: ("legislation"."subscriptions"."status" = 'cancelled' and "legislation"."subscriptions"."cancelled_at" is not null) or ("legislation"."subscriptions"."status" <> 'cancelled' and "legislation"."subscriptions"."cancelled_at" is null)

supporting_material_links_target_check.name: supporting_material_links_target_check
supporting_material_links_target_check.value: "legislation"."supporting_material_links"."bill_id" is not null or "legislation"."supporting_material_links"."amendment_id" is not null or "legislation"."supporting_material_links"."event_id" is not null or "legislation"."supporting_material_links"."organization_id" is not null

votes_target_check.name: votes_target_check
votes_target_check.value: "legislation"."votes"."bill_id" is not null or "legislation"."votes"."amendment_id" is not null or "legislation"."votes"."event_id" is not null or "legislation"."votes"."organization_id" is not null or "legislation"."votes"."chamber" is not null

webhooks_cancelled_at_check.name: webhooks_cancelled_at_check
webhooks_cancelled_at_check.value: ("legislation"."webhooks"."status" = 'cancelled' and "legislation"."webhooks"."cancelled_at" is not null) or ("legislation"."webhooks"."status" <> 'cancelled' and "legislation"."webhooks"."cancelled_at" is null)
